description: This file defines the CapableViewController interface within the OrangeHRM core authorization controller namespace. It declares a single method `isCapable` that determines if a request is capable based on a `Request` object.

classes.name: CapableViewController
classes.description: An interface that requires implementing the method `isCapable`, which evaluates a Request object to determine if the view is capable.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Determines if a request is capable based on the implementation provided in classes implementing this interface.
